parts.html: The K-35 kitchen is a modern straight kitchen built on the contrast between light wood and dark gray-brown fronts. The light wall cabinets and wood-effect backsplash mark out the central work zone, while the base cabinets and tall side units are dark.
The wood texture adds warmth, while the solid gray-brown surfaces provide a calm base. The K-35 is especially fitting where the kitchen is open to the living and dining areas.
It is 4.6 linear meters long, all along one wall: wall and base cabinets, tall side sections, the work surface, and spaces for built-in appliances.
The oven is built in on the left, and the sink and cooktop are in the main work run. When you order, the appliances and sink can be moved to suit your kitchen dimensions and utility outlets.

All the fronts are made of laminated chipboard, so the light wood texture on the upper cabinets is a decor, not solid wood. A backsplash in the same light woodgrain decor ties the central work zone together.
The doors close on Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges; the drawers have Muller telescopic slides without soft-close. Handles are part of the standard configuration.
The standard K-35 has no lift-up mechanisms, cargo pull-out, or island.
K-35 kitchen technical specifications — standard configuration
Color: Gray, with dark gray-brown lower cabinets and tall side sections
Style: Modern
Layout: Straight
Countertop type: Chipboard-based
Overall dimensions: 4.6 × 2.3 × 0.6 m
Lift-up mechanism: None
Appliance installation: Built-in
Cargo pull-out: No
Handles: Included
Upper fronts: Laminated chipboard, light woodgrain decor in the central row
Lower fronts: Laminated chipboard, dark gray-brown solid-color decor
Carcass type: 18 mm laminated chipboard
Length: 4.6 linear m
Island: No
Hinges: Muller Profi Line soft-close
Decor: Combination — light wood, dark gray-brown fronts
Drawer slides: Muller telescopic, without soft-close
Beyond the standard configuration, you can choose higher-grade hardware and mechanisms, additional storage systems, and materials that are more basic or more expensive than the standard ones.
We change the length, the mix of wood and solid decors, the countertop, and the hardware of the K-35 to suit your kitchen.
